milestones.title: Decide and build how a late joiner starts in a cell your organization's server cannot open, with the server items Phase 33 D-33 moved to Phase 35

remediation: A person who joins a shared project late starts each log from the newest checkpoint your organization's server signed, but only in the base cell and the cells granted to that server: the server checkpoints no other cell (the trade-off of Phase 33 D-63), so there the history is read in full. Nothing is left out, and the person is told so. Phase 35, together with the server items Phase 33 D-33 moved there, decides how a late joiner starts in a cell the server cannot open. Source: .planning/phases/33-live-multi-user-staff-projects/33-14-SUMMARY.md and 33-CONTEXT.md D-70.
title: A late joiner starts from a checkpoint only in cells the server holds
